# NFL Daily — 2026-07-29 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- 07/28: Browns CB Denzel Ward agrees to a 2-year, $62.2M extension, again the NFL's highest-paid cornerback. [NYT Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7416864/2026/07/28/browns-denzel-ward-contract-extension/)
- 07/29: Browns S Grant Delpit agrees to a 3-year, $48M extension ($35M guaranteed). [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49481317/sources-browns-grant-delpit-agree-3-year-48m-extension)
- 07/29: Falcons sign QB Cooper Rush as Tua Tagovailoa (back) is limited and Michael Penix Jr. (ACL) is still out of team drills. [NYT Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7477336/2026/07/29/tua-tagovailoa-injury-falcons-cooper-rush/)

- 07/29: Saints DT Bryan Bresee is feared to have suffered a season-ending torn ACL. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49481583/sources-saints-bryan-bresee-feared-torn-acl)
- 07/29: Bengals DE Shemar Stewart was carted off with a left leg injury on Day 1 of camp. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49481418/bengals-shemar-stewart-carted-left-leg-injury)
- 07/29: Panthers rookie WR Chris Brazzell II suffered a moderate LCL tear, expected out up to 8 weeks. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49480858/panthers-rookie-wr-chris-brazzell-injures-knee-having-tests)
- 07/28: 49ers HC Kyle Shanahan takes the blame for the car crash that left him with a concussion. [Fox Sports](https://www.foxsports.com/stories/nfl/49ers-coach-kyle-shanahan-takes-blame-for-the-crash-that-left-him-with-a-concussion)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-07-29 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- 07/29: Ravens open training camp under new HC Jesse Minter; Lamar Jackson says he's playing with new urgency and his best football is still "absolutely" ahead. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/lamar-jackson-believes-best-yet-to-come-calais-campbell-absence-jesse-minter-game-management-2026-training-camp-first-day)
- 07/29: DT Nnamdi Madubuike passes his physical and returns to practice for the first time in 10 months after a neck injury. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49480322/ravens-madubuike-neck-practices-1st-10-months)
- 07/29: DL Calais Campbell isn't practicing to start camp as the team gives him time following the deaths of his mother and brother this offseason; the plan is to have him ready for September. [Jonas Shaffer](https://x.com/jonas_shaffer/status/2082505918814560735)
- 07/29: Without a new deal, the "clock is ticking" on Lamar Jackson's contract situation entering the season. [The Baltimore Banner](https://www.thebanner.com/sports/ravens-nfl/baltimore-ravens-lamar-jackson-contract-YZBN3SJRHBHM3EUHOAEG3HOGBQ/)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- 07/29: DT Nnamdi Madubuike (neck) passed his physical, was activated off PUP, and returned to practice — limited as he ramps back up. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49480322/ravens-madubuike-neck-practices-1st-10-months)
- 07/29: DL Calais Campbell reported to camp but did not practice; team is easing him back in after the deaths of his mother and brother, aiming to have him ready by September. [Jonas Shaffer](https://x.com/jonas_shaffer/status/2082505918814560735)
- 07/29: Also out for Day 1 (PUP/NFI): Corey Bullock (appendix), Teddye Buchanan (knee), Bilhal Kone (knee), John Jenkins (undisclosed), Adisa Isaac (elbow), Travis Jones (pec). [Jeff Zrebiec](https://x.com/jeffzrebiec/status/2082487737341362263)
